ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious AddinUtil.EXE CommandLine Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) with suspicious Addinroot or Pipelineroot paths. An adversary may execute AddinUtil.exe with uncommon Addinroot/Pipelineroot paths that point to the adversaries Addins.Store payload.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\addinutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "AddInUtil\.exe") AND (((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-AddInRoot\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-PipelineRoot\\:.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-AddInRoot\\:\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-AddInRoot\\:\\"\\\.\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-PipelineRoot\\:\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-PipelineRoot\\:\\"\\\.\\.*")) AND (process_working_directory = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_working_directory = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_working_directory = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_working_directory = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_working_directory = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))))
